Subject: Follow-up on recent deployment issues

Hi Grace,

I wanted to personally apologize for the two failed deployments last week. I understand how frustrating that is, especially given your role as Engineering Director, and I appreciate you flagging it directly.

To be transparent about what happened: we implemented a change to our CI/CD pipeline intended to streamline build times. Unfortunately, this update introduced a regression that caused the failures. We have since identified the root cause and are executing a rollback plan to revert the pipeline configuration to its stable state from last Thursday.

We are also conducting an internal review to ensure our staging environment catches these types of regressions before they reach production. I’ll share a brief post-mortem summary with you once the rollback is fully verified and we’ve confirmed stability.

Thanks again for your patience and for holding us accountable.

Best,

[Your Name]
